milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The oak tree canopy is centered at (-5, 5, -8) relative to spawn. Player must navigate within 6 blocks and face the canopy to confirm visual identification. Max_distance=6 requires actual navigation in this compact scene rather than line-of-sight from spawn.

Uses inventory_has because mining soul_sand drops the soul_sand item into the player's inventory. Player starts with no soul_sand. Soul sand drops itself when broken with any tool or by hand. The soul_sand corridor at z=6-9 is the only entrance to the terracotta chamber.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cactus top block is at (6, 2, 8) relative to spawn in the southeast desert area. Max_distance=6 requires the player to navigate to the southern zone and face the cactus to confirm visual identification.

Uses inventory_has because crafting paper (3 sugar_cane in horizontal row → 3 paper) results in paper appearing in inventory. Player starts with no paper. Sugar cane is available from the eastern water feature (9 canes across 3 columns of 3).

Uses inventory_has because crafting a fishing rod (3 sticks diagonal + 2 string vertical → 1 fishing_rod) results in the item appearing in inventory. Player starts with 4 sticks and 3 string but no fishing rod. This craft consumes 3 of 4 available sticks, creating the resource dependency for diamond_hoe.

Uses inventory_has because crafting spruce trapdoors (6 spruce_planks in 2x3 pattern → 2 spruce_trapdoors) results in the item appearing in inventory. Player starts with no spruce trapdoors. Requires multi-step crafting: harvest spruce logs → craft spruce planks → craft trapdoors.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a diamond hoe (2 diamonds top row + 2 sticks vertical below → 1 diamond_hoe) results in the item appearing in inventory. Player starts with 2 diamonds but must craft additional sticks from forest wood since fishing rod consumed 3 of 4 given sticks. Player starts with no diamond hoe.

Uses inventory_has because smelting raw_salmon in a furnace with coal fuel produces cooked_salmon which appears in inventory. Player starts with 1 raw_salmon and 4 coal but no cooked_salmon. This is a furnace smelting operation (independent task with no DAG prerequisites).

Uses inventory_has because mining black_terracotta with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into inventory. Player starts with an iron pickaxe and no black_terracotta. The terracotta is physically enclosed in a stone chamber accessible only through the soul_sand corridor, enforcing the mine_soul_sand → mine_black_terracotta dependency through scene geometry.
